h1: Custom Tri Blend Outerwear for Branded Apparel
metaTitle: Custom Tri Blend Outerwear | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom tri blend outerwear for your team. Soft, durable, and perfect for logos. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Tri blend fabric combines cotton, polyester, and rayon for a soft, lived-in feel that resists pilling and holds up to frequent washing. It drapes better than 100% cotton and breathes more than polyester alone, making it ideal for company jackets, hoodies, and pullovers that employees actually want to wear. Whether you are outfitting a sales team or stocking a company store, custom tri blend outerwear gives your logo a premium look on a comfortable, everyday layer.
heroAltText: Custom tri blend outerwear hoodie with embroidered logo on front
